script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Unbroken Bond

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

JANE (mid 30s, warm, motherly) bakes cookies with her TWINS, EMMA and JAMES (both 8). She looks at them lovingly as they help, her face reflecting happiness and contentment.

JANE
(whispering to herself)
I can't believe they're already eight.

EMMA
Mom, I want to make these all by myself!

JANE
Of course, sweetie. But remember, we need to shape them evenly.

INT. LIVING ROOM - LATER

Jane's HUSBAND, RICHARD (mid 30s, supportive, friendly), enters, carrying a stack of newspapers. He puts them on the coffee table and sits next to Jane, wrapping his arm around her.

RICHARD
You're really getting into this motherhood thing, aren't you?

JANE
(smiling)
I wouldn't trade it for anything, Richard.

INT. SCHOOL HALLWAY - DAY

Emma and James walk hand in hand with their FRIEND, LUCAS (also 8), on their way to school. They share jokes and laughter.

LUCAS
Race you to the bus stop, guys!

Emma and James take off running, their laughter echoing through the hallway.

INT. KITCHEN - EVENING

Jane prepares dinner as Richard enters, carrying a bouquet of flowers.

RICHARD
I thought we could use some flowers on the table.

JANE
(smiling)
You always know how to brighten my day, Richard.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The family gathers around the TV to watch a movie. Lucas and his sister, LUCY (10), join them. They all snuggle together, sharing popcorn and enjoying the film.

EMMA
(to Lucas)
I can't believe you're already ten!

LUCAS
(smiling)
It feels like just yesterday we were all little kids.

JANE
Time really does fly by, doesn't it?

INT. PARK - DAY

The children play on the swings, Lucas and James pushing Emma higher and higher. Jane and Richard watch them from a nearby bench, holding hands and smiling.

RICHARD
They really are growing up so fast.

JANE
I know, but I'm so grateful for every moment.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The family gathers around the dinner table, sharing stories of their day. Lucas and Lucy talk about their school projects, while Emma and James share their favorite parts of their day.

LUCAS
Mom, I made a really cool volcano for science class today!

JANE
(impressed)
Wow, that sounds amazing, Lucas.

RICHARD
And what about you, Jane? What did you do today?

JANE
(smiling)
Just some shopping and errands. But the best part was coming home to this beautiful family.

INT. PLAYROOM - EVENING

Jane and Richard play games with Emma, James, Lucas, and Lucy. They laugh and have a great time, their bond strengthened by their shared experiences.

RICHARD
(to Jane)
I'm so grateful for this family, Jane.

JANE
(smiling)
Me too, Richard. Me too.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
